access_note: Direct fetches of ams.org, pubs.ams.org, doi.org, api.crossref.org and api.openalex.org were blocked by the network policy of the environment used for this revision. The items below were verified through search-engine summaries of the official pages and through the publishers' own landing pages where reachable. The author should re-confirm the journal policy items on ams.org before filing.

sources.name: AMS: About Mathematics of Computation / journal author instructions
verified_items: articles must be of significant computational interest and contain original and substantial mathematical analysis or development of computational methodology
areas: numerical analysis, computational discrete mathematics including number theory, algebra and combinatorics, and related fields such as stochastic numerical methods
preferred initial submission: upload a PDF through the Initial Manuscript Submission form (Centralized Manuscript Processing)
at most three submissions within any 12-month period
2020 Mathematics Subject Classification required in the footnotes of the first page

sources.name: AMS Editorial Committees page: Mathematics of Computation associate editors
verified_items: Markus Bachmayr (Johannes Gutenberg-Universitaet Mainz) listed as associate editor, term 1 Feb 2022 to 31 Jan 2030

sources.name: AMS guidance on generative AI in authoring (Notices, 2024; AMS ethical guidelines)
verified_items: authors must disclose the use of generative AI or AI-assisted tools; AI tools cannot be authors; authors remain responsible for the content
sources.manuscript_consequence: The Declarations section keeps the full disclosure of the previous version (mathematical development and checking, literature search, programming, synthetic-data generation, drafting and revision) and states that the author verified all results and takes full responsibility.
